components.name: release_readiness_audit
components.responsibility: Create deterministic release-readiness evidence from tags, required files, and operator smoke checks.

components.name: release_readiness_validator
components.responsibility: Fail if release-readiness evidence is missing, incomplete, or violates the truth boundary.

components.name: release_readiness_portal
components.responsibility: Provide a human-readable operator acceptance view.

components.name: operator_command_surface
components.responsibility: Expose local operator commands for status, adapters, validation, portals, handover, and logs.

truth_boundary: Default execution remains local deterministic. LangGraph/OpenAI execution remains detected and policy-gated, not falsely claimed as active.
